frequency_question: What proportion of administrative rule finalizations required by court mandate within 30 days are successfully completed on the physical clock without running out of time?
membership_rule: Includes central government agency rulemakings mandated by supreme judicial orders with a strict turnaround window of 30 days or less. Excludes legislative enactments and voluntary administrative actions.

skeleton: Drafting technical parameters (5 days) + Inter-ministerial consultation (10 days) + Legal drafting and vetting by law ministry (7 days) + Formal gazette notification publishing (6 days)
validity_reason: Administrative procedures and bureaucratic drafting speeds remain stable across multi-year cycles.
